mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( id, goods_id, buyer_id, seller_id, pay_type, goods_name, goods_price, goods_image, goods_detail, seller_name, status, pay_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES (#{generatedOrderId}, #{orders.goodsId}, #{orders.buyerId}, #{orders.sellerId}, #{orders.payType}, #{orders.goodsName}, #{orders.goodsPrice}, #{orders.goodsImage}, #{orders.goodsDetail}, #{orders.sellerName}, #{orders.status}, #{orders.payTime}, #{orders.finishTime}, #{orders.createTime}, #{orders.updateTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM orders WHERE buyer_id = #{id} OR seller_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT o.id, o.goods_name AS goodsName, o.goods_image AS images, o.goods_price AS price, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId FROM orders o WHERE o.buyer_id = #{id} OR o.seller_id = #{id} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.goods_id AS goodsId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, o.pay_type AS payType, o.goods_name AS goodsName, o.goods_price AS goodsPrice, o.goods_image AS goodsImage, o.goods_detail AS goodsDetail, o.seller_name AS sellerName, o.status, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.finish_time AS finishTime, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime FROM orders o WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND (o.buyer_id = #{userId} OR o.seller_id = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}) AND status IN (1, 2)
SELECT goods_image FROM orders WHERE buyer_id = #{id} OR seller_id = #{id}
